item.title: 0.1.7 Beta 6
item.description:
# SakuraCord v0.1.7-Beta-6
An unofficial build of SakuraCord's Nightly channel that runs on **macOS 26 Tahoe**. The official app requires macOS 27.
⚠️ This is a nightly build. Expect bugs. It replaces a stable SakuraCord install, because both use the same app ID.
### New in this macOS 26 build - **In-app updates.** SakuraCord can now update itself. Nightly installs follow this nightly feed, and stable installs follow a separate stable feed. Check under Settings → Software Updates. - **Discord Rich Presence.** Games and apps that support Rich Presence can show what you're doing on your profile, including your own profile card in SakuraCord. Turn it on in Settings → Features. Images uploaded to a game's Discord app work, but images given as web links don't show yet. If the official Discord app is open, games connect to it instead.
### New from upstream (v0.1.7 Beta 6) **Files, media and uploads** - File cards with macOS file icons. Downloads save straight to Downloads, with progress and Show in Finder - Quick Look previews for text, code, PDFs and more - Audio cards with a compact player, plus a bigger player in the viewer with 10-second skips - Inline video playback in the timeline, with scrubbing, volume and full screen - Uploads start as soon as you attach files, run in parallel, and can be cancelled or retried - Discord's warning before downloading potentially dangerous files
**Messages and composer** - Discord-style spoilers for text, images, videos, files, embeds and components - More mention types: timestamps with live relative times, @everyone/@here pills, slash-command mentions and game mentions - Reaction animations, and message layouts, Markdown and code blocks that match Discord - Pointing-hand cursor on everything clickable in the timeline
**Channels, friends and calls** - Message Requests under Friends, with Requests and Spam tabs - AutoMod alert messages - Custom message sound and call ringtone pickers - Deafen now also mutes your mic, matching Discord - Fixed text keeping the old theme's colours after switching between Light and Dark
### Also included from Beta 5 - Create Thread from the message menu, a Threads browser, and Join/Leave/Follow/Rename for threads and posts - Rebuilt forum browser, with per-forum memory of sort and view - Unread tracking for forums and threads that follows Discord's rules, plus a clickable new-messages banner - Discord's security check (CAPTCHA) wherever Discord asks for one - Close DM, Add Friend that sends the request directly, and blocked/ignored account management - Nitro upload limit raised to 1 GB
### macOS 26 differences - Drag-to-reorder for input bar icons and profile widgets is unavailable - Some Liquid Glass effects and toolbar spacing are simplified - Inbox tabs use a standard segmented control
### Install 1. Open the DMG and drag SakuraCord into Applications. 2. The app isn't notarized, so the first time, right-click SakuraCord → **Open** → **Open**. If macOS still blocks it, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**.
Requires macOS 26.4 or later. Full upstream changelog: https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/releases
